title: Soda Firing Workshop in San Francisco
host_org: Oribe Firing Center with Uncle Paul's Ceramics
source_quote: Join a three-part workshop series exploring outdoor atmospheric soda firing in collaboration with Oribe Firing Center. The program starts July 25 at the North Beach studio for piece-making using high-fire clay. The follow-up sessions happen in San Gregorio on Sept 26 for glazing and kiln loading, and Oct 3 for unloading and review.
